Zhang's brother-in-law called police. After the incident, they reached compensation agreement; Sun compensated and got victim's forgiveness.

However, typical classification: "故意毁坏财物罪" (intentional damage to property). So that is one charge.

(2) Assault (故意伤害) – He punched Zhang's face. The injury? Not specified severity; just "拳打到脸部". No mention of injury classification. Could be minor injury. Could be "故意伤害罪" if injury is minor. But the victim's face was hit; maybe no medical injury. However, the act of punching is assault. In Chinese law, "故意伤害罪" requires causing bodily injury. If only minor, still counts.
